document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A  burst  of  darkness  and  you  are  sucked  into  the  howling, 
crashing  vortex.  The  earth  and  sky  dance  in  hungry  chaos. 
Everywhere whirls the roaring tides of Otherwhen. You have 
been sucked through the veil to the depths where They swim. 
They come. They come! No, no—not that! Not that!
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
